svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and cup the top of one upright dumbbell at your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and cup the top of one upright dumbbell at your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, keeping your heels down and knees in line with your toes.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, keeping your heels down and knees in line with your toes.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Bottom: Stop at a depth you can control with your whole foot on the floor and the dumbbell close to your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Bottom: Stop at a depth you can control with your whole foot on the floor and the dumbbell close to your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Stand: Push through both feet to rise, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Stand: Push through both feet to rise, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.
